title: Oaths by the Mount and the Coming Punishment

paragraphs.text: Those who do wrong will receive a share of punishment like the share given to the wrongdoers who came before them. Therefore, they should not impatiently ask Allah to hurry it. Woe to the disbelievers because of the Day that has been promised to them, since it is certainly coming.

The next surah, called The Mount, opens with a series of solemn oaths. Allah swears by the mount, and by a Book that is written down on parchment spread open. He also swears by the frequented House, by the heaven raised high above, and by the sea that will be filled with fire. After these oaths, a firm statement follows: the punishment of the Lord will surely happen. No one and nothing will be able to prevent it or push it back, no matter how powerful they think they are.

On that Day, the sky will shake and sway in a circular motion, and the mountains will move away from their places and vanish. It will be a terrible Day for those who denied the truth. These deniers spent their lives in empty talk, playing and amusing themselves, without taking the message seriously. They treated warnings as a joke and never thought about where they were heading.

On that Day, they will be pushed violently toward the fire of Hell. Then the angels will say to them that this is the very Fire which they used to deny when they lived on earth. They will be asked a sharp question: is this magic, as they used to claim about the message, or are they simply unable to see? In the world, they called the truth magic and refused to look at it honestly. Now the reality stands directly in front of them, and they can no longer pretend that it is an illusion or a trick. What they mocked as a story has now become the place where they must stay.
